name: Biteable
tagline: Biteable is an online video maker designed for business teams to create professional-looking videos quickly. Its AI tools include automated scene suggestions for scripts, smart resizing for different platforms, and a library of 1.8 million clips and animations. HR, marketing, and sales teams use it for internal and external communications.
